label: Colour
note: Film stocks and color grading palettes.

options.label: 🎞️ Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm (Rich Tungsten Shadows & Warm Skin)
options.rule: a Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm motion-picture film grade: deep indigo-blue shadow density, natural warm peach-and-amber skin tones, and creamy highlight rolloff

options.label: 🎞️ Fujifilm Eterna 250D (Soft Pastel Contrast & Silky Skin Tones)
options.rule: a Fujifilm Eterna cinema film grade: gentle low-contrast shadow lift, silky-smooth pastel skin rendering, and muted jade-green and warm cream midtones

options.label: 🍷 Velvet Crimson & Champagne Gold (Luxury Boudoir Grade)
options.rule: a luxury boudoir colour grade of deep ruby crimson shadows, luminous champagne-gold highlights, and warm honeyed skin tones

options.label: 🍯 Sun-Drenched Honey Bronze & Warm Amber
options.rule: a sun-drenched honey-bronze colour grade with rich golden skin luminosity, warm amber midtones, and soft ivory highlights

options.label: 🌙 Sapphire Moonlight & Liquid Silver (Crisp Night Cool)
options.rule: a midnight sapphire-and-silver colour grade: deep cobalt-blue shadows, cool porcelain-and-silver skin highlights, and crisp specular contrast

options.label: 🏮 Lush Emerald Green & Tungsten Amber (Arthouse Night)
options.rule: an arthouse night palette of lush jade-emerald shadows contrasted against warm tungsten-amber practical lights and rich skin tones

options.label: 💜 Electric Violet, Magenta & Cyan Dual-Gel Glow
options.rule: a saturated dual-gel neon palette of electric violet and hot magenta on one side balanced against cool cyan-blue on the other

options.label: 🖤 Silver Nitrate High-Contrast B&W (Liquid Metallic Highlights)
options.rule: a silver-nitrate monochrome grade: crushed pitch-black shadows paired with gleaming, liquid-mercury silver highlights on skin and eyes

options.label: 🍑 Airy Peach & Milky Cream (Soft High-Key Glamour)
options.rule: a high-key glamour grade with milky cream highlights, soft rosy-peach skin tones, and lifted airy shadows

options.label: ⚡ Ufotable HDR Elemental Grade (Deep Obsidian Blacks + Blazing Neon Highlights)
options.rule: a high-dynamic-range anime-cinema grade: deep obsidian shadow density contrasted with ultra-saturated, self-luminous cyan, crimson, and gold elemental highlights and warm skin tones

options.label: 💜 Tokyo Velvet Magenta & Champagne Gold (Sultry Boudoir Grade)
options.rule: a sensual Tokyo boudoir grade with rich velvet-magenta shadow tinting, luminous champagne-gold specular highlights, and warm, creamy rose-tinted skin

options.label: 🌴 Sun-Drenched Kodachrome 64 (Vibrant Turquoise, Coral & Golden Tan)
options.rule: a vintage Kodachrome 64 daylight grade with punchy turquoise blues, rich coral-reds, and glowing golden-bronze skin tones

options.label: 🟢 Cyberpunk Gunmetal & Phosphor Emerald (90s Tech-Noir)
options.rule: a sleek tech-noir colour grade with cool gunmetal-slate midtones, deep asphalt blacks, and crisp phosphor-emerald highlights

options.label: Crimson Velvet & Warm Gold Highlights
options.rule: deep ruby crimson midtones and rich obsidian blacks balanced against luminous warm champagne-gold skin highlights

options.label: Electric Cyan Rain & Neon Magenta Blacks
options.rule: saturated electric cyan rain highlights paired with rich ultraviolet and neon magenta shadows

options.label: Warm Champagne Skin & Honey Roll-Off
options.rule: creamy warm champagne-honey highlights giving skin a luminous golden glow with velvety warm chocolate shadows

options.label: Deep Midnight Teal & Luminous Emerald Accents
options.rule: inky midnight blue-teal shadows contrasted sharply with vivid emerald and silver moonlight accents

options.label: High-Contrast Action Bleach-Bypass Steel
options.rule: silver-retained high-contrast bleach-bypass look with desaturated steel blues, punchy deep blacks, and crisp specular highlights

options.label: 🎞️ Fujifilm Velvia 50 (Deep Blacks & Saturated Landscape Punch)
options.rule: a rich Fujifilm Velvia 50 slide-film grade with ink-deep blacks, jewel-bright saturated greens and reds, and punchy daylight contrast

options.label: 🎞️ Kodak Ektachrome Slide Film (Crisp Cool Blues & Fine Grain)

options.rule: a stark monochrome infrared silver-gelatin grade where sunlit foliage glows chalk-white against dramatic jet-black skies and porcelain skin

options.label: Clean True-to-Life Natural Grade
options.rule: accurate neutral color balance preserving natural skin tones, clean whites, and rich subtle shadow density

options.rule: classic cinema teal-and-orange grade with cool cyan-blue shadow contrast lifting warm golden skin highlights

options.label: Rich Vintage Kodachrome Warmth
options.rule: classic Kodachrome slide colors with punchy reds, deep velvety shadows, and warm nostalgic skin

options.label: Warm Amber Golden Glow
options.rule: sun-kissed amber-honey highlights with lifted warm cream midtones and soft shadow rolloff

options.label: Crisp Slate & Silver Thriller
options.rule: cool desaturated steel-blue shadows with crisp silver highlights and taut clinical contrast

options.label: Punchy High-Saturation Gloss
options.rule: vibrant saturated color pop with deep clean blacks and bright luminous highlights

options.label: Soft Airy Pastel Wash
options.rule: gentle low-contrast pastel palette with creamy lifted shadows and soft blossom highlights

options.label: Crisp Monochrome Silver B&W
options.rule: pure achromatic black-and-white silver-gelatin grade with luminous skin highlights and deep ink shadows

options.label: Stark B&W + Selective Crimson Pop
options.rule: high-contrast monochrome black and white contrasted by vivid saturated crimson red on lips, silk, or neon

options.rule: punchy desaturated bleach-bypass thriller grade with crushed dark shadows and metallic skin sheen

options.label: Indie Cross-Processed Cyan & Lime
options.rule: edgy cross-processed film contrast tinting shadows cool emerald-cyan against warm highlights

options.label: Deep Cobalt Moonlight Filter
options.rule: silvery cobalt blue-hour wash transforming scene shadows into cool nocturnal moonlight

options.label: 🎨 Split-Tone Cinema (Warm Gold Highlights / Cool Cyan Shadows)
options.rule: balanced two-hue split-tone curve washing crisp highlights in warm honey-gold while cooling shadows into deep cinema teal-cyan

options.label: 🎞️ Filmic Faded Print (Lifted Velvety Blacks & Creamy Rolloff)
options.rule: soft photochemical print grade with gently lifted charcoal blacks, creamy highlight rolloff, and organic midtone warmth

options.label: 🖤 Silver Gelatin Monochrome (Rich Tonal Range & Crisp Whites)
options.rule: pure silver-gelatin monochrome cinema palette balancing deep ink shadows, luminous silver midtones, and crisp specular skin highlights

options.label: 🌈 Hyper-Saturated Pop (Vivid Candy Primaries & Glossy Contrast)
options.rule: bold high-saturation color palette popping luminous reds, electric blues, and warm skin tones against deep glossy darks

options.label: 📱 Douyin Porcelain Skin + Luminous Neon Cyan/Rose
options.rule: Clean high-clarity Douyin beauty grade with luminous porcelain skin midtones, crisp neutral whites, and vibrant rose-pink and cyan-blue background accents.

options.label: 💖 K-Pop Pastel Milk & Airy Cream Highlights
options.rule: Airy Korean idol music-video color grade with creamy rolled-off highlights, soft peach-milk skin tones, and clean pastel shadow lift.

options.label: 🎞️ Kodak Portra 400 — Natural Warm Skin & Soft Greens
options.rule: Authentic Kodak Portra 400 analog color palette with flattering warm-golden skin tones, gentle sage greens, and smooth highlight transition.

options.label: 🌃 CineStill 800T — Tungsten Night Cool & Red Halation
options.rule: Classic CineStill 800T night film stock grade with cool tungsten-balanced shadows, crisp cyan-blue night ambience, and signature warm red halation around bright bulbs.

options.label: 🎞️ Hong Kong 90s — Deep Emerald Shadows & Sodium Amber
options.rule: Lush 1990s Hong Kong cinema color palette pairing deep emerald-teal shadows with rich sodium-amber highlights and warm saturated reds.

options.label: 🌅 Golden-Hour Sun-Kissed Bronze & Honey Highlights
options.rule: Warm late-afternoon sun-kissed color grade with rich honey-bronze skin highlights, warm amber midtones, and soft violet-blue shadow depth.

options.label: 🎚️ Ultra-Realism: Raw Neutral Rec.709 (True Contrast & Undertones)
options.rule: true-to-life neutral Rec.709 cinema grade preserving natural uneven skin undertones, matte neutral whites, broad midtone separation, deep neutral-black shadow toe preserving dark hair and cloth, and gentle filmic highlight rolloff

options.label: 🎞️ Ultra-Realism: Kodak Vision3 250D Daylight (True Contrast)
options.rule: authentic Kodak Vision3 250D 35mm daylight film grade with honest daylight skin accuracy, crisp natural shadow contrast, muted earthy greens and concrete greys, and gentle highlight compression

options.label: 📽️ Ultra-Realism: Raw 16mm Mixed-Light Contrast Grade
options.rule: candid 16mm documentary color balance with natural mixed tungsten-and-daylight temperature, honest muted shadow tones, and crisp natural contrast bite
